name: Minimalist Linen Overshirt
subtitle: Breathable pure linen overshirt for relaxed layering
description: Crafted from 100% sustainable European flax linen. Features dual flap chest pockets, mother-of-pearl buttons, and a relaxed boxy cut suitable for warm summer evenings.

name: Heavyweight Cotton Hoodie
subtitle: 450 GSM French terry hoodie with relaxed vintage fit
description: Substantial custom-milled heavyweight organic cotton. Garment dyed for deep tonal richness with double-lined hood and sturdy ribbed hems.

name: Tailored Wool Blend Blazer
subtitle: Structured modern blazer with notched lapels
description: Italian virgin wool blend woven with subtle stretch. Softly structured shoulder silhouette with interior ticket pocket and functional horn button cuffs.

name: Raw Denim Selvedge Jeans
subtitle: 13.5oz Japanese indigo selvedge denim
description: Loomed in Kurashiki, Japan on vintage shuttle looms. Classic 5-pocket design with chain-stitched hems, copper hardware, and genuine leather patch.

name: Cashmere Crewneck Sweater
subtitle: Ultra-soft Mongolian cashmere knit in oatmeal heather
description: Spun from Grade-A two-ply cashmere fibers. Delivers exceptional warmth with a featherlight hand feel and timeless ribbed crew collar.

name: Classic Pima Cotton Tee
subtitle: Silky-smooth staple tee from Peruvian long-staple cotton
description: Pre-shrunk Peruvian Pima cotton with double-stitched reinforced collar. Resistant to pilling with an impeccably soft drape.

name: Waterproof Storm Trench Coat
subtitle: Double-breasted weatherproof trench with storm flap
description: Technical cotton-gabardine shell with DWR weatherproofing. Traditional epaulets, belted waist, and deep storm welt pockets for harsh weather elegance.

name: Pleated Wide-Leg Trousers
subtitle: Contemporary high-waisted drape trousers in charcoal
description: Flowy wool-viscose blend featuring clean double forward pleats, slanted pockets, and an effortlessly relaxed architectural leg opening.

name: Suede Harrington Jacket
subtitle: Supple genuine goat suede with ribbed hem
description: Buttery soft goat suede exterior complemented by silky tartan twill lining. Classic stand collar with double snap closures and sturdy brass zip.

name: Ribbed Merino Knit Beanie
subtitle: Cozy 100% extra-fine merino wool in forest green
description: Naturally temperature-regulating merino wool knitted in a chunky 7-gauge fisherman rib. Fold-over brim with subtle woven clip label.

name: Relaxed Utility Cargo Pants
subtitle: Durable cotton ripstop with modular utility pockets
description: Heavy-duty 100% cotton ripstop fabric with reinforced knee panels. Ergonomic bellows cargo pockets and adjustable drawstring ankle cuffs.

name: Retro Suede Street Sneakers
subtitle: Low-top leather and suede panelled gum sole sneakers
description: Premium calfskin leather and suede overlays with cushioned OrthoLite insole and durable vulcanized natural gum rubber tread.
